title: Plaza Theatre (El Paso)

buildingCutout.basis: Replace the building outlined as Plaza Theatre, while retaining adjacent historic structures.

terrainReference.basis: Original bare-earth elevation from USGS 3DEP on the paved approach immediately in front of the marquee.

identities.name: Plaza Theatre (El Paso)
identities.address: 125 Pioneer Plaza, El Paso, Texas, United States

mapIdentity.scope: Named OpenStreetMap way supplies the bounded irregular theatre outline. USDA NAIP locates the large auditorium roof, elevated stage house and the entrance wing.

note: The original Highsmith shot verifies the curved Spanish Colonial Revival gable, small round-arched balcony panel, relief sign, four pairs of doors and the geometric marquee. The theatre plan and technical records distinguish the auditorium from the adjacent mixed-use tower.
